card: One cell-and-tally spine: reconcile stops re-deriving verdict aggregates 3 ways
guard_cases: case 5: one_cell_segment_rows_equal_tone_rows (equal before because both copies were unfiltered; now one tally)
case 6: existing reconcile_aggregates_directive_outcomes_and_says_which_held and tests_scale budget tests unchanged
deviations_from_card: 1) cells::Cell mirrors the sim CellKey axes as strings ('?' for an unknown axis) instead of using shadowrunr_types::results::CellKey directly: CellKey requires instrument_hash and audience_size, and reconcile loads runs without spec.json / instrument.json; Cell sorts tone,tier,segment,audience,hash so single-hash sources keep their old order. 2) No CheckFilter enum: every tally is hard-rules-only, so one fn. 3) failure_lines (excerpt sampling) still includes cited lines of broken prevent directives - it produces no published number, and those lines are the evidence for the new 'directives' entry. 4) Added: directive outcomes go into the prompt's metrics block as 'directives' (only when present) - without it the synthesis would lose sight of broken directives once they left the tone rule rows. 5) RunData::core_tier/matrix_segment/cell are added via an impl block in cells.rs, so runs.rs (StreamEvent match, overlord-a6) was not touched; tests.rs/tests_scale.rs untouched. 6) runs_with_fail/usable_runs/tier_decisions live in results.json, which reconcile does not read (it reads run dirs), so there was nothing to reuse.
notes: Test commit 1505ef6 compiled with 4 assertion reds. While building, the workspace clippy/check was red only on a sibling's uncommitted daemon prep work (prep/revise.rs); I verified HEAD + my files in an exported tree under the scratchpad (clippy, fmt, workspace tests all green), then after the sibling committed edf81fb, re-ran every gate in the real checkout: all rc=0. Finding outside the write set: shadowrunr-sim summary.rs cell rules/runs_with_fail also count directive:prevent:* as hard-rule failures (summary.rs:385-392), so results.json can still disagree with reconcile's directive-free tallies - worth a card for sim-runner-judging.
